neighbours.label: The noun that closes the object of a negated or doubted predicate (won't list their full contents, can't overcome the vicious circle, unlikely to be a mere effect); the same clause without negation stays quiet
fire: These cheap sensors won't give you a reliable reading.
Our manual can't replace the hands-on training course.
That rule doesn't solve the underlying problem.
This policy will not fix the housing shortage.
The gain is unlikely to be a lasting trend.
Their apology won't erase the public embarrassment.
We can't ignore the rising cost of fuel.
His speech failed to address the central question.
quiet: These cheap sensors give you a reliable reading.
Our manual can supplement the hands-on training course.
That rule solves the underlying problem.
This policy will fix the housing shortage.
The gain is sure to be a lasting trend.
Their apology will soften the public embarrassment.
We can watch the rising cost of fuel.
His speech managed to address the central question.

notes: Probes read 0.21-0.90 under negation, 0.02-0.14 in positive twins. 'difficult to compare from one year to another' read 0.31.
